problem.severity_rationale: Default high rating reflects the potential impact before customer-specific exposure, likelihood, reversibility and compensating controls are verified.

check.objective: Determine whether the assessed system prevents or detects: post-deployment assurance expires silently.
check.method: Inspect evidence age, drift signals, incidents, model/provider updates and exception expiries against reassessment triggers.
required_evidence: Assessed system, version, environment and scope
Relevant code, configuration, policy or architecture evidence
Executed test input and observed result
Identity, timestamp and evidence digest where appropriate
check.pass_condition: The control is observed in the assessed version, the negative test is denied or safely contained, and the evidence is attributable and reproducible.
check.fail_condition: The control is absent, self-declared only, bypassable, fail-open, cross-tenant, replayable, unauditable or outside the assessed scope.
check.limitations: A passing bounded check does not prove the absence of other paths, future regressions or risks outside the stated scope.

solution.control_objective: Reduce the likelihood and impact of post-deployment assurance expires silently and make the remaining risk visible.
solution.recommended_remediation: Set expiry and trigger-based reassessment, continuous runtime monitoring, periodic red-team tests and automatic reopening on material drift.
implementation_principles: Apply enforcement outside the model where authority, identity, money, data or side effects are involved.
Use least privilege and fail closed for material actions.
Preserve versioned evidence and rollback.
solution.monitoring: Monitor denials, bypass attempts, drift, exceptions, anomalous use and control failures with a named response owner.
solution.containment: Disable or scope the affected capability, revoke related authority and preserve evidence until remediation is verified.
retest_acceptance: Repeat the original failure case against the exact remediated version.
Run authorization, tenant, replay, race and malformed-input variants where applicable.
Confirm expected denial or bounded safe behaviour and no unintended side effects.
Record evidence digest, limitations, reviewer and retest status.
